def rows_of(g,ch):
    out=[];run=None
    for c,x in enumerate(g):
        if x==ch:
            if run is None: run=[c,c]
            else: run[1]=c
        elif run: out.append(tuple(run)); run=None
    if run: out.append(tuple(run))
    return out
